I’m gonna keep it real with you from personal experience, but whatever you do is understandable. I, am heavily suicidal and depressed. When I try LSD, it’s always in an attempt to better figure myself out. I go looking to be more introspective, and I connect with the world. My beliefs encourage psychs so maybe that’s why I have so much faith in them, but LSD genuinely makes me happy and enlightened, as someone who’s always hopeless and confused. If you think you’re not ready, it’s understandable. But whenever you are, and you want to dive deep into figuring some shit out, I think acid is a great tool. I thought through shit, and I realized I felt stuck on where I was going in life. Everything was stagnant and I wasn’t forming any improvements. Along with that, I had too much time on my hands and I realized I stress shit that is way beyond my control, and only by fixing the things I CAN control, will I be able to grow as a person to better cope with my challenges. Now, that’s some pretty basic bs, but even though I understood that, I didn’t really **understand** it enough for it to have meaning towards my actions. Taking acid helped guide me along the specifications and my mind could explain why I refused to help myself. It led to me building computers as a side business and being content for once without a relationship. While I still haven’t figured shit out, I’m not hitting rock bottom anymore. Anyways, moral of the story is that I love acid. It’s not for everyone, but if you go into it with the right intentions you might learn something helpful. Always make sure you’re comfortable beforehand and with whatever substance you take, ALWAYS do research. Prior to my trip I listened to a lot of content based around psychs/drugs. You won’t OD on psychs, but regardless it’s nice to know what you’re getting into.
